album.title: Albums
album.subtitle: A local-first AI photo library. Every file stays on your disk.
album.emptyHint: Create your first album, then import a folder.
album.photoEmptyHint: This album has no photos yet. Import a folder to get started.
album.noMatchHint: No photos match the current filters. Try adjusting them.
album.deleteConfirm: Remove album “{name}” from the list? Its folder and files stay on disk and can be linked again later.
album.importRootPlaceholder: Choose or type a local folder to import
album.nameTooLong: Album name must be at most 120 characters
album.importHint: Supported photos and videos are copied into the album. The source folder is never read again or modified; duplicate content is recorded in duplicate groups.
album.createdHint: Create an album, then import a local folder.
album.similarComputing: Computing similarity in the background. This view refreshes automatically.
album.trashSubtitle: Deleted media stays here and still occupies disk space.
album.trashHint: Restored items return to the photo grid; permanent deletion removes the stored file.
album.purgeConfirm: Permanently delete this item? The stored file will be removed and cannot be recovered.
album.purgePartial: Deleted {removed}; {failed} file(s) failed and remain in the trash
album.cleanTrashConfirm: Empty the trash? All stored files will be removed and cannot be recovered.
album.settingsSubtitle: Only affects this album; stored in index.json
album.featuresHint: Leave empty to follow the global settings.
album.pixivEnableHint: Detect filenames such as 127978234_p0.jpg and load titles, artists, tags and page info. Account and network settings live in global Settings → Pixiv.
album.pixivAutoDownloadHint: Off by default; download manually from the detail panel. Enable to fill gaps when opening details.
album.exportHint: Copies every photo to the chosen folder and writes picturex-export.json with uuid, filename, sequence ID and taken / added / modified times.
album.gridHint: Ctrl/⌘ + wheel or pinch to change columns
album.gridMax: Up to {max} columns on this screen
album.coverHint: The newest imported photo is used by default; you can also pick one from this album.
album.coverAutoRestored: The newest photo is used as the cover again
album.tagsSubtitle: A photo can carry several tags; tag master data lives in tag.db
album.tagColorOptional: Leave empty to auto-color from the tag name
album.tagRandomColorConfirm: Apply random colors to all tags? Existing colors will be overwritten.
album.tagDeleteAllConfirm: Delete all {count} tags? Tag links on photos will also be removed; this cannot be undone.
album.tagDeleteConfirm: Delete tag "{name}"? Links on photos are removed too
album.tagOpenHint: Click a tag to view its photos
album.tagImportInvalid: No importable tags found in the file
album.tagImportFailed: Could not parse the tag file; choose a JSON exported by this app
album.batchDeleteTagsConfirm: Delete {count} selected tags? Their photo links are removed too.
album.mergeConfirm: Merge the other selected tags into “{name}”? Links move to the target and the source tags are deleted.
album.customPathHint: Type an absolute path or use Browse…; leave empty to use the data directory.
album.pathMissingHint: The album directory was moved or deleted; it reappears once restored.
album.missingBannerHint: Check the disk or network path, or delete the registration.
album.linkHint: Pick a directory that contains index.json; only the path is registered, no files are moved or copied.
album.unlinkHint: Removes it from this list only. The album folder and its files stay on disk; use "Link existing album" to add it back.
album.exportCancelled: Export cancelled; incomplete files were removed
album.thumbStorageHint: Thumbnail BLOBs live in thumbnails.db; automatic maintenance runs when idle or hourly.
album.thumbAutoOff: Automatic optimization is off (manual optimize still available)
album.thumbOptimized: Removed {removed} thumbnails and compacted the database
album.thumbClearConfirm: Clear all thumbnails in this album? They will be regenerated on demand when browsing.
album.thumbCleared: Thumbnail cache cleared; thumbnails regenerate on demand
album.pathCorruptHint: index.json is not valid JSON; fix it or restore a backup before opening.
album.corruptBannerHint: The files are still on disk; repair index.json or restore a backup. The app will not overwrite it.
album.batchPurgeConfirm: Permanently delete the {count} selected items? Their stored files are removed and cannot be recovered.
album.thumbWarmupHint: Generates the smallest {size}px thumbnails in added order with {concurrency} decode slot(s), suitable for slow HDD reads; safe to pause anytime.
album.thumbWarmupRestartConfirm: Rescan from the beginning and generate thumbnails? Existing thumbnails are skipped quickly.
album.thumbWarmupCancelled: Cancelled; you can resume or restart

asset.title: Media
asset.deleteConfirm: Move “{name}” to the trash? The file is kept and can be restored.
asset.previewUnsupported: This format cannot be previewed in the browser
asset.viewerHint: Scroll to zoom, drag to pan · Press ? for shortcuts
asset.shortcutPlay: Play / pause animation or Live Photo
asset.sourcePath: Source path (record only; files are never changed)
asset.deleteDuplicateConfirm: Remove the duplicate record for “{name}”? The file on disk is not deleted.
asset.batchDeleteFilesConfirm: Remove {count} selected duplicate records? Files on disk are not deleted.
asset.cleanupConfirm: Clear every duplicate record? Only the records are removed; files outside the album folder are never touched.
asset.cleanupDone: Cleared {groups} groups and {cleared} duplicate records; no files were changed
asset.batchDeleteAssetsConfirm: Move {count} selected photos to the trash? They can be restored later.
asset.importingHint: Import progress appears on the jobs page.
asset.pixivAuthHint: Configure a Pixiv token to read restricted works and download missing pages.
asset.pixivStale: Pixiv refresh failed; showing cached details.
asset.pixivPagesHint: Click a downloaded page to switch to it.
asset.pixivInvalid: This work was deleted or is no longer visible on Pixiv. Auto-sync is stopped; refresh to retry.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Data folders, thumbnails, AI, similarity, appearance and language.
settings.pathsHint: Paths are persisted in setting.json and apply to new jobs.
settings.qualityHint: Applies to thumbnails generated from now on; clear the cache in album settings to rebuild existing ones.
settings.autoOptimizeHint: While idle, evict over-limit/corrupt thumbnails, truncate WAL and VACUUM when fragmented.
settings.cacheFirstHint: Browsing only uses thumbnails already cached in the global library and never waits for original decoding; missing ones are queued in the background and appear automatically.
settings.accelHint: GPU acceleration requires the FP16 model. Falls back to CPU when the backend is unavailable or fails to load.
settings.accelPackHint: {model} is not installed yet. Download its FP16 entry on the Models page.
settings.themeOverridesHint: Only tokens in the theme whitelist can be overridden. Clear a field to restore its default.
settings.languageHint: Changes apply instantly; the next start follows the cookie.
settings.storageHint: Albums use local disk by default; remote backends are stubs.
settings.partitionHint: Switch partition every 8192 files (sequence mode only).
settings.thumbnailHint: BLOBs live in thumbnails.db and are LRU-evicted to 90% of the cap.
settings.aiHint: Download local models below; the external endpoint is OpenAI Chat Completions compatible.
settings.modelHint: Model files live under the models root; download state is in .download/index.json.
settings.ffmpegHint: Video thumbnails and metadata require ffmpeg.
settings.unsupported: This setting is unsupported in the current environment
settings.subtitlePixiv: Pixiv account, page cache and regional networking
settings.pixivNotLoggedIn: No Pixiv token configured. Restricted works and page downloads require token sign-in.
settings.pixivTokenHint: The token is stored only in local setting.json and masked in API responses.
settings.pixivNetworkHint: Direct works when Pixiv is reachable; proxies support HTTP CONNECT and SOCKS5, defaulting to socks5://127.0.0.1:10808.
settings.pixivAutoFetchSpeedHint: Only affects metadata request spacing; cached works do not wait, and missing pages are never downloaded.
settings.pixivAutoFetchPausedNotice: Background enrichment paused; progress is saved and the pause survives restarts
settings.pixivAutoFetchPausedHint: Resuming skips processed works per album; failed works are not retried for 30 minutes.
settings.pixivAutoFetchErrorDisabled: Pixiv is disabled for this album
settings.pixivAutoFetchErrorRateLimited: Pixiv rate limit reached; slowing down and waiting
settings.subtitleLanguage: Interface language and default locale, applied instantly
settings.subtitleStorage: Data directory, album root and storage backend
settings.subtitleMedia: Thumbnail sizes, quality and video frame extraction
settings.subtitleSimilarity: pHash hamming threshold and similar grouping
settings.subtitleAi: Tagging mode, local models and external API
settings.subtitleModels: Download, verify and remove local models

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.subtitle: Live progress for imports, AI tagging and model downloads.
jobs.diskIdle: Nothing is reading or writing the disk right now
jobs.diskHint: Only in-app disk activity is listed, not byte-level throughput; thumbnails currently run {concurrency} in parallel, last one took about {ms} ms.
jobs.emptyHint: Import an album or download a model and the job shows up here.
jobs.deleteJobConfirm: Delete this job record? Imported photos are not affected.
jobs.clearTabConfirm: Clear {count} finished job(s) in this tab? Running or paused jobs are kept.

models.title: Models
models.subtitle: Local ONNX models with resumable downloads.
models.brokenHint: This FP16 build is incompatible with the bundled ONNX Runtime and cannot be downloaded or selected. Use the quantized model instead.
models.removeConfirm: Remove model “{name}”? Downloaded files are deleted from disk.
models.cleanupHint: Removes installed models that are not selected in AI settings; the models currently in use are kept.
models.cleanupConfirm: Remove every installed model that is not in use? Downloaded files are deleted from disk.
models.corruptedHint: Checksum failed. Download the model again.
models.taskHint: Progress and task state live in .download/index.json.
models.availableHint: Download once, then use it offline.

theme.title: Appearance
theme.previewSub: This is how secondary text looks.
theme.applyHint: Changes apply instantly and are written to setting.json.
theme.subtitle: Presets and themable design tokens, applied site-wide

viewer.desktopOnly: The viewer only runs inside the desktop app
viewer.fileGone: The file is gone or unreadable

library.title: Global library
library.subtitle: Loose images opened in the viewer, deduplicated by content.
library.tagsOpenHint: Click a tag to view its images in the library
library.emptyHint: Images opened with the desktop viewer will appear here automatically

pixivLibrary.title: Pixiv library
pixivLibrary.subtitle: Every Pixiv work known to the data root, browsable outside albums; covers load on demand and are never written to local files.
pixivLibrary.searchPlaceholder: Search title, artist, tag or work ID
pixivLibrary.emptyHint: Adjust the filters, or import Pixiv images into an album with Pixiv enabled first.
pixivLibrary.detailPending: This work only has a placeholder row. Details and previews appear after it is fetched.
pixivLibrary.manageHint: Syncing merges details from albums with Pixiv enabled; enrichment only fetches metadata and tags, never images.
pixivLibrary.detailInvalid: This work was deleted or is no longer visible on Pixiv. Auto-sync is stopped; use refresh to retry.

home.defaultAlbumHint: Loose images opened in the viewer, {count} total
home.featureLocalBody: Each album is self-contained: metadata, indexes and originals live in the album folder and can be moved together; thumbnails are cached under the data root.
home.featureDedupBody: SHA-256 finds exact copies; pHash finds visually similar shots for side-by-side review.
home.featureAiBody: Built-in CLIP zero-shot and ViT-GPT2 captioning, with an optional OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
